name: Spoon University
description: Through culinary knowledge and delicious content, our mission is to open students' eyes to the world of food. Cooking doesn't have to be scary, but an opportunity to explore. It's a way to bring people together, share stories and tap into our roots from different parts of the world. Whether you're a writer, photographer, designer or marketing guru, Spoon celebrates everything you bring to the table. name: Student Organ Donation Advocates
description: empower high school and college students to increase organ, eye, and tissue donation registration through peer-to-peer education, advocacy, and on-campus events; mission is to bridge the donation gap by reducing registration barriers and inspiring young people to become lifelong donors and advocates
